headline: CIN @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 3.87 at NYM 5.05, with a projected total of 8.92. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (CIN -0.48, NYM -0.50), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.98, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Nolan McLean has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Steer, Juan Soto, Blake Dunn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Luis Torrens because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
